cards.cardName: Wayne Gretzky #1 ["1978 Indianapolis Racers", National Sports Cards]
cards.notes: Looks like a scarce 1978 pre-rookie at first glance, but it's actually the 1991 National Sports Cards "1978 Indianapolis Racers" set -- unlicensed, a tribute/novelty card made in 1991 depicting his 1978 WHA season, not an original vintage issue (confirmed via Trading Card Database: single-card unlicensed set). His real, valuable rookie is the 1979-80 O-Pee-Chee #18 (not owned/not this card). Raw asks $10-25 on eBay (no single point value found); not tracked on SportsCardsPro at all (no confirmed graded sold comps). One "KSA 10" asked $290, but KSA is a minor grading company, not a real PSA comp. Cool piece for the collection, not a grading candidate.
